title: Cloud bread
summary: Feather-light rounds of whipped egg white and cream cheese — a modern low-carb invention for sandwiches.
steps: Heat the oven to 150 °C (300 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Whip the egg whites with the cream of tartar to stiff, glossy peaks.
In another bowl, beat the yolks, cream cheese, salt and baking powder until smooth.
Fold a third of the whites into the yolk mixture to lighten it, then fold in the rest gently, keeping as much air as you can.
Spoon into 6 rounds about 1.5 cm (½ in) thick on the sheet.
Bake 25–30 minutes, until golden and firm to a light touch. Cool on the sheet; they firm and become flexible as they rest.
dairy_free_notes: Dairy-free cream cheese makes a looser yolk mixture, so the rounds spread more and bake flatter; fold very gently and bake a few minutes longer.
tips: Store in a bag with the rounds separated by parchment; they turn soft and bread-like overnight.

origin.history: Cloud bread is a modern invention of low-carb home cooks, circulating in the United States from the 2000s and later popular on social media. It imitates soft sandwich bread using whipped egg whites for lift; there is no traditional dish behind it.
